deployments_detail.use: "MAX" (Mazda AI Transformation) unit established Sep 2025, ~400 staff, company-wide generative AI deployment beyond R&D into operations
deployments_detail.value: goal: double productivity by 2030 (target, not result)

deployments_detail.use: Agentic AI PoC with Protiviti for internal audit functions (Azure)

Machine-learning-driven design space exploration and calibration to accelerate vehicle design/development and reduce reliance on expensive physical simulations. Long-running partnership (3+ years) with commercial deployment of solutions; Mazda also invested in Secondmind's funding round. [Secondmind]

AI-driven simulation and design optimization for in-vehicle audio/acoustics (speaker performance, speaker grille and full-vehicle interior acoustics 20Hz-20kHz), used in model-based development to cut prototypes. [Siemens (Simcenter HEEDS, Simcenter 3D, NASTRAN)]
deployments_detail.value: Speaker-grille simulation cut from 2.5 days to 4 hours; full analysis of 8 speaker models in 2 hours

deployments_detail.use: In-car AI voice assistant: the all-new 2026 Mazda CX-5 is the first Mazda to ship with Google built-in (Google Assistant, Google Maps, Google Play), with the Google Gemini conversational AI assistant arriving in a future software update. [Google (Google built-in, Assistant, Gemini)]

Broader use of generative AI to accelerate vehicle design and early development via increased virtualization and data-efficient models, reducing time and cost and lessening the need for expensive physical simulations. [none]

GenAI RAG assistant for technical service hotline agents, combining warranty/repair history, diagnostic codes and service documents to guide technicians through unfamiliar repairs. Built by Mazda North American Operations on Databricks (Unity Catalog, Vector Search, MLflow 3, Databricks Apps/Streamlit, Foundation Model API). Went from kickoff to working concept in ~8 weeks, tested with 10 service agents. [Databricks]

Service-department program in which dealership technicians record personalized inspection/repair videos for customers, reinforced by AI feedback/coaching. Rolled out and trained across Mazda's ~550 US dealerships to drive service retention and loyalty. [none]
deployments_detail.value: Customers 95% more likely to return; trained across 550 dealerships

deployments_detail.use: AI-produced television/social commercial for the MX-5 relaunch in the South African market, generated with Luma's AI agents by agency Boundless. Mazda's first AI-produced commercial, completed in under two weeks from brief to final approval. [Luma AI (Luma Agents); agency Boundless]

Consolidation of ~30 years of simulation/model-based-development and CAD data onto Dell PowerScale to build a data lake supporting AI workloads; managed with Dell InsightIQ AIOps, SnapshotIQ and SyncIQ. Deployed to support model-based development and future generative-AI workloads. [Dell Technologies (PowerScale, InsightIQ)]
deployments_detail.value: Capacity expanded ~4PB to 10PB; ~90% reduction in storage cost per unit

deployments_detail.use: Enterprise conversational-AI tools rolled out for administrative work (accounting, procurement, HR, PR), part of a productivity drive. Mazda uses Microsoft Copilot and OpenAI ChatGPT while also building a proprietary in-house AI system. An AI transformation department (~70 staff, expanding to ~400) was created in Sept 2025. [Microsoft (Copilot), OpenAI (ChatGPT)]
deployments_detail.value: Goal to double productivity by 2030 (5 people do work of 10)

deployments_detail.use: AI-assisted pilot to automate Mazda's monthly global production report, which had taken ~50 hours to compile across disparate systems. Also testing AI translation and voice synthesis for multilingual executive communications. Part of the same administrative-productivity program. [none]
deployments_detail.value: Global production report compilation reduced from ~50 hours
